text: The buildings are: turbine hall (GT and ST), control and electrical building, GIS building, administration building, workshop / warehouse, water treatment building, gatehouse and fire station (ER-13.02). Steel frames with cladding shall be used for the turbine hall and the workshop; reinforced concrete or composite frames for the control and electrical building; the buildings shall have fire compartments and escape routes per the Fire Regulation and the HSE design criteria (HS-DBR-0001).
